title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the electric field intensity as E = (3mg)/(4q) or equivalent simplified form.

title: Equilibrium force analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must resolve forces in equilibrium, relating tension, weight, and electric force using the given angle.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem or conservation of energy to find the speed at the lowest point.

title: Circular motion tension
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion at the lowest point to relate tension, weight, and centripetal force.

title: Final tension magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the final tension as T = (3mg)/2 or equivalent simplified form.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize sign errors in force components, incorrect work done by electric force, or wrong direction of acceleration in circular motion.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The solution shows clear algebraic steps to derive the final expressions from the governing equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution maintains dimensional consistency or mentions units for physical quantities.
